Name: Margin_01
Title: In the margin, Rib Stair
Text: Too stiff. Loosen the wrist. She should look as if she might turn over.

Name: Margin_02
Title: In the margin, Rib Stair
Text: Ribs: eleven a side, not twelve. Nobody will count. I will know.

Name: Margin_03
Title: In the margin, Cartoon Gallery
Text: Leave the far side. They will want something left to do.

Name: Margin_04
Title: In the margin, Cartoon Gallery
Text: These steps hold if you look at them. Good enough for now. Come back to this.

Name: Margin_05
Title: In the margin, behind the paint
Text: The little ones keep turning out like me. Stop it. Give this one a different nose.

Name: Margin_06
Title: In the margin, near the Heart
Text: Warmest place in the picture. Put it here.

Name: Margin_07
Title: In the margin, the Heart wall

Name: Margin_08
Title: In the margin, the Heart wall
Text: Third try at the hands. I cannot do my own hands. I cannot do my own back at all. Who is there to ask?

Name: Odile_01
Title: Odile's note, the lower gate
Text: H. thinks I'm fetching flax. H. always knows when I'm lying and lets me, which is the whole secret of a marriage.

Name: Odile_02
Title: Odile's note, the First Well
Text: Ilka's right about the ticks. Don't tell her.

Name: Odile_03
Title: Odile's note, the Sunward Clearing
Text: Met the half-seen lad. He looked at my lantern and said 'that one's going down and not coming up', then apologised for twenty minutes.

Name: Odile_04
Title: Odile's note, the Rib Gate
Text: It's cold coming out of her. Not air. Cold the way a room is after someone's left it.

Name: Odile_05
Title: Odile's note, the Cartoon Gallery
Text: The Hand left notes. THE HAND LEFT NOTES. It worried about noses.

Name: Odile_06
Title: Odile's note, before the Heart
Text: Figures on the wall with a lantern and a knife. Limners, then. We're older than I thought. Two of them, and a clean place where a third was. Not rubbed. Rubbing leaves a smear. There are footprints in the charcoal dust, bare, walking out.

Name: Odile_07
Title: Odile's note, the Heart
Text: There's a hollow by her heart the shape of someone sleeping, and nobody in it, and she is so cold, H. It's like a bed gone cold on one side. I've no pigment left to paint her anything. I've oil for the night. I'm going to lie down in it and keep the lamp by her till morning and then come home and you can shout at me. If I'm late: the wick wants trimming on the left. It always did. It's not a fault. It's how I knew it was mine.

Name: Ledger_Hesper
Title: Hesper's lamp-log
Text: One line a day for forty years. Oil per night, in fingers. Three fingers. Three. Three and a half. Four. The number has never once gone down.

Name: Ledger_Ilka
Title: Ilka's ledger
Text: Blood-well warmth, by season. The oldest column begins eleven years ago with a note in the margin: 'new instrument? no. same instrument.' Every figure below it is a little smaller than the one above.

Name: Ledger_Bartram
Title: Bartram's receipts
Text: A spike of old bills. Madder, one bolt's worth, 'for O.V., who will not be told'. Ceruse, bought by the pound and sold by the pinch, back when nobody knew.
